g.text: Buck EN left open (internal pull-up = on); PG unused. Pi fed by a 10 cm 20 AWG USB-C pigtail (no USB-PD):

g.desc: Buck EN left open (internal pull-up = on); PG unused. Pi fed by a 10 cm 20 AWG USB-C pigtail (no USB-PD):

g.text: set usb_max_current_enable=1. ESC branch is protected only by the keyed XT90 - never hot-plug.

g.desc: set usb_max_current_enable=1. ESC branch is protected only by the keyed XT90 - never hot-plug.

g.text: SURANG avionics - power distribution and signal interconnect | 6S 3300 mAh | Pixhawk 6C Mini + Raspberry Pi 5

g.desc: SURANG avionics - power distribution and signal interconnect | 6S 3300 mAh | Pixhawk 6C Mini + Raspberry Pi 5

g.text: P. 6S power: battery, power module, ESC, protected 5 V rails

g.desc: P. 6S power: battery, power module, ESC, protected 5 V rails

g.text: F. Flight controller, RC, cassette servo

g.desc: F. Flight controller, RC, cassette servo

g.text: LiDAR PWM tied to GND = internal 10 Hz scan

g.desc: LiDAR PWM tied to GND = internal 10 Hz scan

g.text: Scout XIAO 3V3 LDO feeds RFM95W (peak ~0.47 A)

g.desc: Scout XIAO 3V3 LDO feeds RFM95W (peak ~0.47 A)

g.text: All logic is 3.3 V: FC UARTs, Pi GPIO,

g.desc: All logic is 3.3 V: FC UARTs, Pi GPIO,

g.text: LiDAR Tx, ESP32-C3. No level shifters.

g.desc: LiDAR Tx, ESP32-C3. No level shifters.

g.text: Single-point ground at the PM; signal

g.desc: Single-point ground at the PM; signal

g.text: harnesses carry their own GND wire.

g.desc: harnesses carry their own GND wire.

g.text: PM02 60 A cont./100 A burst -> cap total

g.desc: PM02 60 A cont./100 A burst -> cap total

g.text: the band - keep RC on high channel hop

g.desc: the band - keep RC on high channel hop

g.text: and the scout on Wi-Fi ch 1/6/11 plan.

g.desc: and the scout on Wi-Fi ch 1/6/11 plan.

g.text: Not built; values are design targets.

g.desc: Not built; values are design targets.

g.text: M1 front-R CCW, M2 rear-L CCW,

g.desc: M1 front-R CCW, M2 rear-L CCW,

g.text: M3 front-L CW, M4 rear-R CW

g.desc: M3 front-L CW, M4 rear-R CW

g.text: IR: 2 strings x (2 x 850 nm 1 W LED + 4.7R) = 2 x ~0.37 A from 5 V (Vf ~1.6 V each); Q1 low-side, PWM dimmable on GPIO12.

g.desc: IR: 2 strings x (2 x 850 nm 1 W LED + 4.7R) = 2 x ~0.37 A from 5 V (Vf ~1.6 V each); Q1 low-side, PWM dimmable on GPIO12.

g.text: Pump: 370-class diaphragm pump, ~0.3 A at 5 V, low-side Q2 + SS14 flyback; GPIO13 PWM sets sample flow.

g.desc: Pump: 370-class diaphragm pump, ~0.3 A at 5 V, low-side Q2 + SS14 flyback; GPIO13 PWM sets sample flow.

g.text: Gate network: 100R series (edge/ringing) + 100k pull-down = load OFF while the Pi boots or is unpowered.

g.desc: Gate network: 100R series (edge/ringing) + 100k pull-down = load OFF while the Pi boots or is unpowered.

g.text: AO3400A: logic-level (Vgs(th) <= 1.45 V, Rds(on) ~ 40-50 mOhm at 2.5-4.5 V), 30 V / 5.7 A.

g.desc: AO3400A: logic-level (Vgs(th) <= 1.45 V, Rds(on) ~ 40-50 mOhm at 2.5-4.5 V), 30 V / 5.7 A.

g.text: Break-beam receiver is open-collector: pulled up to the Pi 3V3 (R1) so 5 V never reaches GPIO17.

g.desc: Break-beam receiver is open-collector: pulled up to the Pi 3V3 (R1) so 5 V never reaches GPIO17.

g.text: L. Switched loads on +5V_AUX: 850 nm illuminators, sample pump, break-beam

g.desc: L. Switched loads on +5V_AUX: 850 nm illuminators, sample pump, break-beam

g.text: C. Companion computer, LiDAR, camera, scout radio node

g.desc: C. Companion computer, LiDAR, camera, scout radio node

g.text: S. I2C sensor buses (3.3 V, Pi-hosted)

g.desc: S. I2C sensor buses (3.3 V, Pi-hosted)

g.text: TELEM2 <-> Pi UART0: MAVLink2 921600 8N1, no flow control (BRD_SER2_RTSCTS=0). VCC pin not connected.

g.desc: TELEM2 <-> Pi UART0: MAVLink2 921600 8N1, no flow control (BRD_SER2_RTSCTS=0). VCC pin not connected.

g.text: ESC: DShot600 on FMU AUX1-4 (SERVO9-12; IO MAIN outputs do not do DShot). Servo: AUX5 = SERVO13 PWM.

g.desc: ESC: DShot600 on FMU AUX1-4 (SERVO9-12; IO MAIN outputs do not do DShot). Servo: AUX5 = SERVO13 PWM.

g.text: RC: FS-iA6B iBUS -> RC IN (if not decoded, move to a spare UART with SERIALx_PROTOCOL=23).

g.desc: RC: FS-iA6B iBUS -> RC IN (if not decoded, move to a spare UART with SERIALx_PROTOCOL=23).

g.text: TELEM1: optical flow + ToF (MSP, 115200) for GPS-free Loiter in the gallery.

g.desc: TELEM1: optical flow + ToF (MSP, 115200) for GPS-free Loiter in the gallery.

g.text: Failsafes: RC + GCS loss -> brake/hold -> land; battery 2-stage (BATT_LOW/CRT); props idle when perched.

g.desc: Failsafes: RC + GCS loss -> brake/hold -> land; battery 2-stage (BATT_LOW/CRT); props idle when perched.

g.text: I2C1 (GPIO2 SDA / GPIO3 SCL), 400 kHz-1 MHz, Pi on-board fixed pull-ups:

g.desc: I2C1 (GPIO2 SDA / GPIO3 SCL), 400 kHz-1 MHz, Pi on-board fixed pull-ups:

g.text: 0x33 MLX90640 thermal array (alone on the bus so it can run FM+)

g.desc: 0x33 MLX90640 thermal array (alone on the bus so it can run FM+)

g.text: I2C3 (GPIO6 SDA / GPIO7 SCL, dtoverlay=i2c3-pi5), 100 kHz, R2/R3 4.7k pull-ups:

g.desc: I2C3 (GPIO6 SDA / GPIO7 SCL, dtoverlay=i2c3-pi5), 100 kHz, R2/R3 4.7k pull-ups:

g.text: 0x77 DFRobot factory default - left unused so a fresh sensor cannot collide

g.desc: 0x77 DFRobot factory default - left unused so a fresh sensor cannot collide

g.text: Gas boards: SEL DIP = 0 (I2C), powered from 3V3 so SDA/SCL never exceed 3.3 V.

g.desc: Gas boards: SEL DIP = 0 (I2C), powered from 3V3 so SDA/SCL never exceed 3.3 V.

g.text: CH4 NDIR (Ambetronics OEM) is planned on UART/RS-485 via an adapter, not on these buses.

g.desc: CH4 NDIR (Ambetronics OEM) is planned on UART/RS-485 via an adapter, not on these buses.

g.text: Protected 5 V branches (fuse + TVS crowbar: reversed battery -> TVS conducts -> fuse opens)

g.desc: Protected 5 V branches (fuse + TVS crowbar: reversed battery -> TVS conducts -> fuse opens)
